content:
alice.g: Heads up — for the canary rollout UI I sketched a small addon: 'Audit snapshot' that shows all policy / routing / quota edits tied to the rollout window. Should be downloadable as NDJSON for compliance teams. :spiral_notepad:

ben.k: Love it. Do we need full object diffs or just summary lines? :eyes:

carlos.s: Full diffs are expensive to index. My proposal: store compact patch + anchor ts, surface readable summary in the UI, and offer the full patch only in the export. Need tenant_id + actor metadata in every event.

devon.p: Agree on compact diffs. Suggest API shape for exports: GET /api/v1/audit/exports?since=1689990000&until=1690000000&tenant=org_123&format=ndjson&redaction=pii_none
Sample NDJSON event (one line per event):
```
{"ts":"1690000001","actor":"alice.g","actor_hint":"alice@redwood","actor_type":"user","actor_key_id":null,"tenant":"org_123","action":"policy.update","path":"/routing/policies/42","summary":"changed default route to region-eu","patch":"{\"before\":...,\"after\":...}","justification":"canary traffic tweak"}
```

emma.security: Important: exports must support redaction modes (pii_none, pii_mask, pii_strip) and be gated by RBAC (audit_admin role). Also require KMS-wrapped export bundles when requested. Retention defaults should still apply (we don't keep exports forever).

ben.k: UX idea: on rollout page show a collapsed 'Audit snapshot' card with a short count + top actors, quick filter by actor/action, and a 'Download export' CTA that kicks off an async job + console notification. Prefer background job so UI doesn't block.

alice.g: Notification pattern: create job -> return job_id; client polls /jobs/:id or we push a console notification when ready. Can we reuse existing "export jobs" infra?

carlos.s: We can reuse the job queue but need a different payload schema (actor_hint, justification, patch). Also watch out for storage cost for full patches — maybe keep full patches for 90 days, summaries longer.

devon.p: Edge case: changes via API keys should surface `actor_type: key` and `actor_key_id`, but mask the token. Also include `request_origin` (console/api/terraform) when available.

audits-bot: export job queued (job_id=aj_2023_3890) — status: queued

alice.g: Next steps: devon + carlos prototype export API and example payload; ben/ux wire up button state + filtering; emma write RBAC/redaction requirements; product will draft compliance acceptance criteria. Sync Friday 10:00am? :calendar:local:10:00

ben.k: Works for me :thumbsup:

carlos.s: Quick note on quotas: exporting full patches for a large tenant should consume export-quota units. We should add a throttle and cost-warning modal.

devon.p: I'll add a quota check in the job submission path and surface estimated size before enqueue. Example response on submit: `{"job_id":"aj_2023_3890","estimated_size_bytes":12400000,"quota_cost_units":12}`

alice.g: Perfect. Keeping the initial scope small (snapshot + NDJSON export + RBAC) — we can iterate on per-tenant retention and signed bundles after the prototype. Thanks all.
